changes: Selected English paragraphs from a historical revision, omitted section labels and other passages, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Historical 2008 English Wikisource excerpts for 134:6 and the main text of 134:13. Section 13 omits Rema glosses and is marked partial. Section 2 is not imported: the excerpt says wine touched by a non-Jew where the Hebrew refers to ordinary non-Jewish wine, and also contains omissions. The excerpts were compared with the local Hebrew; the historical revision does not itself prove the translation method or underlying source.
